Messages.Author: Tom Kassel
Messages.Body:
I've been thinking about ways to use the Coven effectively. It seems clear
that the blood gain can be used at various stages during combat to gain
enough
blood to play additional cards or absorb damage. I'm wondering about a
specific case. Assume I have a 2 cap vampire with two blood. The opposing
minion strikes for four damage. Can I spend two blood for the first two
points of damage, tap the Coven to gain two more and then spend these two
for
the final points, thus avoiding torpor?

Tom

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tom Kassel wrote:
>
> I've been thinking about ways to use the Coven effectively. It seems clear
> that the blood gain can be used at various stages during combat to gain
> enough
> blood to play additional cards or absorb damage. I'm wondering about a
> specific case. Assume I have a 2 cap vampire with two blood. The opposing
> minion strikes for four damage. Can I spend two blood for the first two
> points of damage, tap the Coven to gain two more and then spend these two
> for
> the final points, thus avoiding torpor?

No. Damage is all handled in the same instant. As in the case
of Renegade Garou taking three damage and Vagabond Mystic
attempting to save him.

Also, you can't tap coven to allow a 2-capacity vampire to pay for
a card that costs 4 blood - the cost of a card is also paid all at
once.
